test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "at."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****
 

__
 
• The preposition** "at"** is used in the blank to indicate the direction of the gaze or attention.
 
• The sentence suggests that if you want a pet that looks directly in your direction, a horse would be suitable.
 
• Here,** "at"** is used to convey the idea of looking toward or facing the person, emphasizing a direct and focused gaze.
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct paragraph:

It is often said that if__ you want a pet to look up to you, get a dog. If you want a pet that looks straight __**at**__ you, get a horse. For an animal that looks down ______ (3) ______ you, the cat must surely ______ (4) _______ this description. Cats are their own bosses. They have little or no regard for anyone or anything. If you have ______ (5) ________ looked closely at the cat, you will observe that it looks at you from the corner of its eyes, almost condescendingly. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• By: **We use **by + noun** to describe how someone travels or communicates, or how things are processed
 
• **To: **We can use **to** to indicate a goal or a direction of movement, as well as a place of arrival.
 
• **Over: **We use **over** to talk about movement or position at a higher level than something else.
